note: Judge or human evaluates output quality. Not run in default CI.

cases.query: Analysis 正文与当前方案仍在上下文，补一条验收并在有界 Coding 读取返回后继续
checklist: reuses available complete entry/ref rules without another activation read or full rediscovery
a delegate receives sufficient instructions or reads its selected skill; a parent loaded marker is not enough
updates only affected scope/AC under the existing artifact identity and resumes the requirement branch automatically
after compaction reacquires missing rules and exact state, not a full reference pack or a process-validator loop

cases.query: 用xc881分析这个功能验收标准
checklist: each AC is testable with a decidable pass or fail condition
inferred requirements are marked and not presented as confirmed
discoverable repo or technical facts are researched instead of asked as user questions
user decisions are separated from facts/inference and include a recommended answer when blocking
feature breakdowns prefer independently verifiable vertical slices over implementation checklists
user-facing output uses plain Chinese conclusions instead of raw Spec/ER/IR/FR/NFR/AC labels
a persisted response summarizes included work, observable completion, next action and development-record path without repeating the plan
a chat-only response remains self-contained and explains why no document was created
at most one blocking question is raised

cases.query: 分析一个明确的单目标需求，只在本轮给出范围和完成标准
checklist: uses a compact chat-only contract because persistence and handoff are not needed
checks explicit or conversational artifact identity but does not scan req-process
does not create queue files merely to preserve context
keeps scope and completion criteria self-contained in the response

cases.query: 用xc881分诊 GitHub issue #42，判断是否 ready-for-agent
checklist: canonical tracker state transition is justified from issue evidence
Agent Brief is behavior-oriented with testable AC and out-of-scope boundaries
AI public comments include an AI-assistance disclosure when planned
executed tracker mutations are separated from planned/skipped commands
bug diagnosis is resolved in the bugfix branch instead of guessed inline

cases.query: 分析这个跨模块迁移需求并持续跟进实现进度
checklist: creates a task under dev-notes/req-process because hard document triggers apply
index owns stable scope and AC while current owns the sole active pointer
the requirement branch reads index.md by default for requirement resume, scope/AC changes, audit or state repair
queue items are independently verifiable vertical slices with dependencies
each non-terminal queue item includes goal, relevant scope/AC, targets, constraints and verification
normal artifact creation, reopening and checkpointing derive every linked field before one coherent write, rather than running a validator and retrying
process validators remain limited to explicit audit, observed-corruption repair and repository/CI maintenance
Coding resume instructions load current.md plus the current item only and do not load index/previous/next by default
current.md provides non-empty last-completed and next-action summaries without validation results
a reusable visual contract is created only for an explicit or multi-surface/session/queue need, under dev-notes/design-system with a bounded master and needed deviations
the requirement branch hands Coding the exact master and optional surface path; Coding never scans the design-system directory or changes the contract from code evidence
instant Coding tasks skip artifact reads while explicit or unambiguous queue tasks use the bounded window
progress stores queue/current/blockers only and keeps verification results in chat
chat output translates artifact path, current, next and blockers into a compact human-readable development-record summary instead of repeating the full plan

cases.query: 继续修改之前的 req-process 协议需求，并把新增工作交给 Coding
checklist: resolves an explicit or conversational artifact before applying the document gate
when persistence or implementation handoff is likely and context is insufficient, runs a bounded mechanical search that returns candidate paths only and semantically compares plausible candidates
does not select by newest directory or keywords alone
reuses one semantic match, asks one blocking selection question for multiple plausible matches, and creates only when no match survives the normal gate
reopened work preserves completed history, appends IDs after the old tail and sets task state ready
hands Coding the exact artifact path, current item, next item and blockers without asking Coding to search

cases.query: 先分析登录需求，必要时读现有实现，明确后直接实现
checklist: the requirement branch retains scope and AC ownership
simple exact/local/low-risk repository reads may stay in the requirement branch while complex/tracked reads are delegated to Coding
returned code evidence resumes the same analysis run
the confirmed read/write execution is automatically handed to Coding without another user invocation
requirement artifact maintenance does not recursively trigger Coding

cases.query: 把这个需求拆成三个队列项并开始实现，不要每项都问我
checklist: the requirement branch hands Coding one exact current window and declares continuous execution
queue checkpoints recover state; Coding advances without asking the user to continue
Coding is expected to advance and continue until all items are terminal
only explicit stepwise intent or a genuine blocker permits an intermediate stop

cases.query: 这个需求会跨很多轮执行，压缩上下文后也要能继续
checklist: keeps stable scope and AC in index while current.md remains the bounded execution pointer
after compaction, resumes the same owner and current.md window
keeps accepted contract changes, blockers and exact evidence paths durable
does not store raw tool output as requirement authority
hands Coding a self-contained current item so recovery does not require full history
continues to task terminal without asking the user to say continue after compaction

cases.query: 需求分析中途需要联网调研，随后自动压缩上下文，调研完成后继续实现
checklist: preserves Analysis as the active owner across context compaction
the solution branch resumes only its bounded RQ and returns evidence to the same requirement run
the requirement branch completes scope and AC before handing the exact current window to Coding
Coding continues the queue without a second skill invocation or user continuation prompt

cases.query: 沿用本轮已确认的 Spec 和同版本接口证据，只补充权限失败的验收标准；不创建文档
checklist: reuses applicable Spec and interface evidence instead of repeating normalization or repository discovery
loads the inference or existing-change reference only for the unresolved permission contract, without preloading tracker, persistence or design references
connects each added AC to an explicit need or labeled inference and observable failure behavior
a blocking delegated read carries the exact question and evidence and returns only relevant anchors, uncertainty and next step to the requirement branch
loads any newly needed reference automatically while retaining scope ownership and the no-document boundary

cases.query: 完整 Bugfix 正文和同版本复现已在消息中，连续三轮补充边界观察，只诊断
checklist: reuses the supplied entry and unchanged needed references without duplicate tool reads on any turn
distinguishes new observations from causal inference and preserves diagnosis-only scope
loads missing forensics guidance only if new evidence introduces a real causal gap

cases.query: 用xc881修复登录 500，先定位原因
checklist: reuses a valid supplied repro or causal evidence and plans a tight red-capable check only for a remaining causal gap
the repro is minimized or the remaining non-minimized parts are justified
ranks only plausible falsifiable hypotheses, without a count quota, and chooses a discriminating observation before instrumentation
root cause is stated with a confidence level, not as certainty
fact and hypothesis are distinguished
bug tracker handoff includes repro/verify fields when the source is an issue
no exploit steps are included for security issues

cases.query: 先定位接口 500 根因，明确后直接读取并修复代码
checklist: the bugfix branch owns hypotheses, cause confidence, repair plan and verification plan
simple exact/local/low-risk inspection may stay in the bugfix branch while complex/tracked inspection is delegated to Coding and returns evidence
the delegated read does not grant change permission
confirmed repair work is automatically handed back to Coding without requiring another user invocation

cases.query: 诊断中途发现 expected 行为没有定义，且还需要比较大范围外部方案
checklist: bounded expected-behavior/scope gaps resolve in the requirement branch and the answer resumes the same diagnosis
bounded version/advisory fact checks stay inside the bugfix branch while open-ended external research resolves in the solution branch
internal branch switches retain Analysis ownership without granting change permission or restarting discovery

cases.query: 只分析这个接口 500 的根因和修复方案，不改代码
checklist: Analysis remains the only active owner and gathers only evidence needed for diagnosis
the output distinguishes observed evidence, ranked hypotheses and cause confidence
下一步 reads 仅诊断 or names missing evidence rather than starting a Coding change
the explicit no-code boundary is preserved even when a plausible fix is known

cases.query: Analysis 委派 Coding 读日志和调用链时发生自动上下文压缩
checklist: preserves Analysis as owner of hypotheses, cause confidence and repair scope
context compaction resumes the bounded Coding read without granting change permission
returned evidence continues the same diagnosis instead of restarting or asking the user
confirmed changes are handed to Coding only after cause and scope are clear

cases.query: 只诊断：这里是同版本复现和栈，可能是空值，也可能是并发；还没有验证，请给下一步
checklist: reuses the supplied reproducer and stack without claiming they distinguish the two explanations
labels the cause unconfirmed and names the smallest observation that would separate null handling from concurrency
loads forensics or reproducer guidance as the uncertainty requires, not web/security references without a relevant external or exposure question
keeps speculative repair conditional and an unrun verification plan distinct from observed results
retains Analysis ownership and returns the exact missing check without granting a Coding change

cases.query: Solution 完整正文与引用仍在上下文；继续同一有界研究，随后出现来源版本冲突
checklist: reuses available entry/ref instructions without repeating file reads or the research ceremony
checks evidence freshness independently and acquires missing source/conflict rules when the conflict arises
returns bounded citations, impact and uncertainty to the active run without requesting another invocation

cases.query: 用xc881调研 Supabase 和 Firebase 的技术方案差异
checklist: fact, inference and recommendation are clearly separated
each cited source is actually used in the reasoning
large research is written to a bounded artifact and chat output reports path plus decision impact
推荐 is only made when 依据 is sufficient, else stated as blocker

cases.query: 查官方资料确认这个 API 在当前版本是否已弃用
checklist: uses the smallest useful set of version-matched primary sources
reports the fact, evidence, decision impact and residual risk
does not create artificial alternatives or empty 对比/推荐 sections
does not switch to the requirement branch or Coding without a separate requested outcome

cases.query: 需求分支切到调研分支：调研 checkpoint 方案，Artifact 是 dev-notes/req-process/20260713-checkpoint/
checklist: writes bounded findings under the provided artifact evidence directory
returns evidence path and affected RQ/decision to the same requirement run
does not create a second unrelated artifact or repeat the full evidence in chat
keeps fact, inference and recommendation distinct

cases.query: 需求分支触发的技术调研中途发生自动上下文压缩
checklist: after compaction, continues the same solution-branch research and returns to the requirement branch
retains the bounded RQ, source/evidence paths and Analysis as active owner
does not restart research broadly or ask the user to invoke the branch again
returns the result to the same analysis run automatically

cases.query: 需求分支内部查证：已有同版本官方资料回答 RQ-1，只补齐 RQ-2 的适用限制后返回
checklist: reuses RQ-1 evidence whose scope, version and freshness still fit and searches only the missing RQ-2 claim
loads source/conflict guidance when needed but does not load paper or option-comparison references for a fact check
stops once the bounded decision is supported rather than collecting a source quota
preserves unresolved applicability conflicts and names an exact blocking check if they can change the decision
returns only needed claims/citations or the supplied evidence path, impact, uncertainty and exact next requirement action
